$comment: Tool-selection eval cases. Questions are taken verbatim, or lightly adapted, from the EXAMPLES/WHEN sections of the tool descriptions as they existed on main BEFORE the description rewrite (commit be1584c). Sourcing them from the pre-change text keeps the dataset from being written to fit the new wording; if anything it favours the old descriptions. 'acceptable' lists alternates a competent engineer would also accept; keep it strict or the eval measures nothing.
